After an unusually long three-week wait, Apple today released iOS 27 beta 5, bringing new app icons for the Siri app, Safari, and more.

Apple rolls out app icon updates with iOS 27 beta 5

iOS 27 is getting closer to public release, with a launch scheduled for next month.

Today's beta 5 brings some user-facing changes in preparation for that official launch.

Among them, several system apps have received fresh icons:

  • Siri
  • Safari
  • Preview
  • Settings
  • Remote

You can see a number of the new icons in the image above. Some other apps also appear to have received fairly subtle updates.

Starting with the first beta, iOS 27 has been rolling out design changes across more icons, as Apple continues refining last year's Liquid Glass aesthetic.

Maps, Photos, Wallet, and others were refreshed from the very start of iOS 27. But the revisions in beta 5 show Apple's icon tweaks for iOS 27 are not yet done.

What do you think of the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Let us know in the comments.
